description.p: TUI Weathergirl is a personal terminal weather and disaster monitoring station which is also very much focused on the users with various medical conditions, visually impaired users and the users with friends and relatives scatered in various places on the planet as it gives them a way to monitor both the time, sky situation and temperature in real time for 10 additional places on Earth. Application also gives opportunity to monitor the weather in any of the Antarctic research stations and just any spot on Earth.
